contents: A finished tournament: 31 matches, all completed, every one with real teams. Trimmed to 4 covering the series-length spread (a 3-1 BO5, a 2-0, a 2-1, and an 0-2).

verification.verbatim: elements are verbatim; the top-level array was truncated from 31 to 4 and nothing else was altered
verification.noStateField: confirmed — /matches has no state field. State must come from /brackets or be derived from scores and maps.

knownGap: Contains no TBD match, because the tournament is over. The TBD convention (teamA and teamB both plain null) is captured in esports-world-cup-2026-cs2_brackets.json instead.

recapture.reason: CS2 via BLAST is off the roadmap (SPEC §0, §8: "a second source is last"). scripts/capture-fixture.ts only knows the Riot REST envelope; BLAST is a different API entirely (api.blast.tv/v2) with no shared client.
